description: SecretSchemaProvider interface and connector implementations: add optional SecretSchemaProvider interface, SecretField struct, ConnectorRegistry interface with AllConnectors(), implement SecretSchema() on all connectors, update connector Open() methods to prefer SecretsFrom, and add GET /admin/connectors/schema endpoint.

acceptance_criteria: SecretSchemaProvider interface exists and connectors implement it via type assertion
Each connector (postgres, mysql, valkey, kafka, rabbitmq, rest) implements SecretSchema()
GET /admin/connectors/schema returns all connector schemas as JSON
Kafka Open() supports SASL auth when saslMechanism setting is present
RabbitMQ Open() supports discrete settings with secret injection
REST Open() injects resolved secrets as HTTP headers
All existing tests pass plus new tests for SecretSchema and schema endpoint
